meta.name: Sample L1/L2 Support Knowledge Base
meta.note: Simulated data for an internship assignment. Systems, services, teams and codes are fictional or generic. Not taken from any production environment.

entries.title: Payment API returns HTTP 500 Internal Server Error
symptoms: POST /v1/payments returns 500 Internal Server Error
Sudden spike in failed transactions on merchant dashboard
Error message: 'Something went wrong, please retry'
possible_causes: Unhandled exception in payment-service after a recent deployment
Database connection pool exhausted
Downstream acquirer/bank gateway failing and error not handled
diagnostic_checks: Check payment-service application logs for stack traces around the failure time (filter by request/trace ID)
Check whether a deployment happened in the last 24 hours (release/CI-CD history)
Check DB connection pool metrics (active vs max connections) on the monitoring dashboard
Check health/status of downstream acquirer and bank gateway integrations
Confirm whether failures affect all merchants or only one merchant/payment method
entries.known_resolution: If a recent deployment introduced the error, roll back to the previous stable version. If the DB pool is exhausted, follow KB-012. If a downstream gateway is failing, enable failover routing to the secondary acquirer if available and notify the gateway partner.

entries.title: Payment API timeouts (HTTP 502 / 504 Gateway Timeout)
symptoms: Requests to payment API return 502 Bad Gateway or 504 Gateway Timeout
Merchants report payment page keeps loading and then fails
API latency p95/p99 is much higher than normal
possible_causes: Upstream service (bank/acquirer) responding slowly
Load balancer cannot reach healthy backend instances
Backend pods overloaded (high CPU/memory) or crash-looping
diagnostic_checks: Check load balancer target health: are backend instances marked healthy?
Check pod/instance CPU, memory and restart counts
Compare latency of internal service vs upstream bank calls in APM traces
Check whether traffic volume is unusually high (sale event, retry storm)
Check the status page of upstream bank/acquirer partners
entries.known_resolution: Scale out backend instances if overloaded. Restart crash-looping pods after capturing logs. If an upstream bank is slow, apply the circuit breaker / route to alternate acquirer. Ask merchants to use idempotency keys when retrying to avoid duplicate charges.

entries.title: API requests fail with 401 Unauthorized / invalid API key
symptoms: Merchant integration receives 401 Unauthorized
Error: 'Invalid API key' or 'Authentication failed'
Integration worked before and suddenly stopped
possible_causes: Merchant is using test (sandbox) keys against production or vice versa
API key was rotated or revoked
Authorization header formatted incorrectly
diagnostic_checks: Confirm the environment: sandbox key prefix vs live key prefix matches the endpoint URL
Check in the merchant admin panel whether the key is active, rotated or revoked
Ask merchant for a sample request (with key masked) to verify the Authorization header format
Check if the merchant account is suspended or KYC is pending
entries.known_resolution: Ask the merchant to use the correct environment key, or generate a new key from the dashboard if it was revoked. Never ask the merchant to share the full key over chat or email.

entries.title: API requests rejected with 429 Too Many Requests
symptoms: Merchant receives HTTP 429 Too Many Requests
Error: 'Rate limit exceeded'
Happens during peak hours or bulk operations
possible_causes: Merchant exceeding their configured requests-per-second limit
Retry loop in merchant code without backoff
Bulk status polling instead of using webhooks
diagnostic_checks: Check the merchant's request rate in the API gateway dashboard vs their configured limit
Look for repeated identical requests indicating a retry loop
Check whether the merchant is polling payment status instead of consuming webhooks
entries.known_resolution: Advise exponential backoff on retries and webhook usage for status updates. If the merchant has a genuine business need, raise a rate-limit increase request.

entries.title: UPI transaction stuck in PENDING state
symptoms: Customer paid via UPI but status shows PENDING
Amount debited from customer but merchant has not received confirmation
Order not confirmed after UPI payment
possible_causes: Delayed response from the customer's bank or UPI switch
Callback/webhook from the UPI partner not received
Network timeout between payment service and UPI partner
diagnostic_checks: Look up the transaction by transaction ID / RRN in the admin console and check its latest status
Check whether the status-check (reconciliation) job has run for this transaction
Check UPI partner callback logs for this transaction ID
Check if there is a known UPI/bank downtime notice for the customer's bank
entries.known_resolution: Trigger a manual status check for the transaction. Most pending UPI transactions auto-resolve within the bank's TAT (typically up to T+1 business day). If finally FAILED, the debited amount is auto-reversed by the bank. Share the RRN with the customer for follow-up with their bank.

entries.title: Card transaction declined
symptoms: Customer's card payment is declined
Decline response code received from issuer (e.g. 05, 51, 54, 91)
Multiple customers report declines on the same card network
possible_causes: Issuer decline: insufficient funds (51), expired card (54), do not honor (05)
Issuer or switch unavailable (91)
Fraud/risk rule blocking the transaction
diagnostic_checks: Get the response code from the transaction details in the admin console
If a single customer: interpret response code and advise customer to contact their bank
If many customers on one issuer/network: check decline-rate dashboard by issuer for a spike
Check whether an internal risk rule flagged the transaction
entries.known_resolution: Single customer, issuer decline: ask the customer to contact their card issuer or use another payment method. Spike for one issuer with code 91: treat as issuer downtime and inform Payments Operations. Risk rule blocks go to Risk team for review.

entries.title: 3D Secure / OTP authentication failure
symptoms: Customer does not receive OTP for card payment
3DS page fails to load or shows an error
Transaction fails with 'Authentication failed'
possible_causes: Issuer ACS (Access Control Server) down or slow
Customer's mobile number not updated with the bank
Browser blocking the 3DS redirect/iframe
diagnostic_checks: Check if failures are concentrated on one issuing bank (ACS issue)
Check 3DS authentication success-rate dashboard
Ask the customer to try another browser / disable popup blockers
Confirm the customer's mobile number is registered with their bank
entries.known_resolution: If ACS issue for one bank, inform Payments Operations and post a status note. For individual customers, advise retrying, checking registered mobile number with the bank, or using an alternate payment method.

entries.title: Customer charged twice (duplicate debit)
symptoms: Customer reports two debits for one order
Two successful transactions with the same amount and order ID
Duplicate charge after customer clicked Pay twice or retried
possible_causes: Merchant retried without an idempotency key
Customer clicked Pay multiple times
First transaction was pending and later succeeded after customer retried
diagnostic_checks: Search transactions by order ID / customer reference to confirm both are SUCCESS (not one PENDING/FAILED)
Check if both requests carried the same idempotency key
Check if one of the debits is a pending authorization that will auto-reverse
entries.known_resolution: If two successful captures exist for one order, initiate a refund for the duplicate transaction (see KB-011 for refund tracking). Advise the merchant to implement idempotency keys.

entries.title: Merchant not receiving payment webhooks / callbacks
symptoms: Merchant says order status is not updating after payment
Webhook delivery failures in the dashboard
Merchant server not receiving callback notifications
possible_causes: Merchant webhook URL incorrect or unreachable
Merchant server returning non-2xx response
Merchant firewall blocking our IP ranges
Signature verification failing on merchant side
diagnostic_checks: Check webhook delivery logs for the merchant: HTTP status returned and error
Verify the configured webhook URL (HTTPS, publicly reachable)
Confirm the merchant has allow-listed the published webhook source IPs
Ask merchant to check signature verification using the current webhook secret
entries.known_resolution: Correct the webhook URL or merchant server issue, then replay failed webhooks from the dashboard. Advise merchant to use the status API as a fallback.

entries.title: Merchant settlement delayed
symptoms: Merchant has not received settlement amount in bank account
Settlement report shows status ON_HOLD or PENDING
Settlement amount lower than expected
possible_causes: Bank holiday / settlement cycle (T+1, T+2) not yet complete
Settlement on hold due to KYC or risk review
Incorrect merchant bank account details (payout bounced)
Deductions: refunds, chargebacks or fees
diagnostic_checks: Check the merchant's settlement cycle and whether there was a bank holiday
Check settlement status and hold reason in the settlement console
Verify merchant bank account details and any payout bounce/return
Review settlement report for refunds, chargebacks and fee deductions
entries.known_resolution: If within cycle, inform the merchant of expected date. If on hold, ask merchant to complete pending KYC/documents. If payout bounced, ask merchant to update bank details and re-trigger payout after verification.

entries.title: Refund not reflected in customer account
symptoms: Customer says refund not received
Refund shows PROCESSED in dashboard but customer has not got money
Refund stuck in PENDING
possible_causes: Refund within bank processing time (typically 5-7 business days for cards)
Refund failed because card was closed/blocked
Insufficient merchant balance to process refund
diagnostic_checks: Check refund status and ARN/RRN in the admin console
Check refund date against standard TAT for the payment method
Check for refund failure reason (closed card, insufficient merchant balance)
entries.known_resolution: If processed, share the ARN/RRN with the customer so they can trace it with their bank. If failed, re-initiate refund via alternate method (e.g. bank transfer) per policy. If merchant balance is insufficient, ask merchant to top up.

entries.title: Database connection pool exhausted
symptoms: Errors like 'too many connections' or 'Cannot acquire connection from pool'
Application requests hang then fail
DB active connections at maximum on dashboard
possible_causes: Connection leak in application code (connections not closed)
Long-running queries holding connections
Traffic spike beyond pool size
diagnostic_checks: Check DB active/idle connections and max_connections
List long-running queries and blocking sessions on the database
Check application logs for connection leak warnings
Correlate with traffic and recent deployments
entries.known_resolution: Kill confirmed runaway queries (with DBA approval), restart affected application instances to release leaked connections, and raise a ticket to fix the leak or tune pool size.

entries.title: Reconciliation mismatch between transactions and settlement
symptoms: Daily reconciliation report shows mismatched transactions
Transaction SUCCESS in our system but missing in bank file (or vice versa)
Settlement total differs from transaction total
possible_causes: Late status update (pending later turned success/failure)
Bank MIS file delayed or incomplete
Timezone/cut-off difference between systems
diagnostic_checks: Identify mismatched transaction IDs from the recon report
Check latest status of each mismatched transaction
Confirm the bank file for that date was received completely
Check cut-off times used by both systems
entries.known_resolution: Re-run reconciliation after receiving the complete bank file. Mark late-status transactions for next-cycle settlement. Remaining unexplained mismatches go to the Settlements team.

entries.title: POS terminal offline / not connecting
symptoms: POS terminal shows 'No Network' or 'Host not reachable'
Terminal status Offline in the terminal management console
Transactions fail with connection error at the store
possible_causes: SIM/data issue or weak signal
Store Wi-Fi down or changed password
Terminal not registered/activated in the management console
diagnostic_checks: Check terminal last-seen time in the terminal management console
Ask merchant to check signal/Wi-Fi icon on the terminal and restart it
Ask merchant to switch between SIM and Wi-Fi if both are available
Verify terminal is activated and mapped to the correct merchant ID
entries.known_resolution: Restart the terminal and reconnect to network. If SIM issue, switch to Wi-Fi or arrange SIM replacement. If not activated, activate and map terminal in console. Still offline after this: raise a field-service visit.

entries.title: POS card reader not detecting card (chip / tap / swipe)
symptoms: Terminal shows 'Card read error' or 'Insert card again'
Tap (contactless) payments not detected
Chip cards failing but swipe works
possible_causes: Dirty or damaged chip reader
Contactless disabled in terminal configuration
Customer card damaged
diagnostic_checks: Ask merchant to try a different card to rule out a damaged customer card
Check terminal configuration for contactless enabled
Ask merchant to clean the chip slot with a cleaning card
Check terminal hardware error logs in the management console
entries.known_resolution: Enable contactless in configuration if disabled and push config. If hardware fault persists across multiple cards, arrange terminal replacement.

entries.title: POS receipt printer not printing
symptoms: Transaction succeeds but no receipt is printed
Terminal shows 'Paper out' or 'Printer error'
Printed receipt is blank
possible_causes: Paper roll empty or inserted wrong side (thermal side facing in)
Printer cover not closed properly
Printer hardware fault
diagnostic_checks: Ask merchant to check the paper roll and orientation (thermal side facing out toward print head)
Ensure the printer cover is fully closed
Run a test print from terminal settings
entries.known_resolution: Reload paper correctly. If test print fails with correct paper, arrange terminal repair/replacement. The transaction itself is valid; a duplicate receipt can be reprinted from the terminal's last-transaction menu.

entries.title: POS terminal stuck during software update
symptoms: Terminal stuck on 'Updating...' or boot logo
Terminal restarts repeatedly after update
Terminal app version not updated
possible_causes: Network interruption during download
Low battery during update
Corrupted update package
diagnostic_checks: Check update job status for the terminal in management console
Ask merchant to connect terminal to charger and stable network
Check if other terminals on the same update batch report failures
entries.known_resolution: Keep terminal on charger and stable network, then retry the update from the console. If multiple terminals fail on the same batch, pause the rollout. Boot-looping terminals need replacement or field visit.
entries.escalation_team: POS Field Support / Terminal Software team

entries.title: Merchant dashboard login failure
symptoms: Merchant cannot log in to the dashboard
Error: 'Invalid credentials' or 'Account locked'
Login OTP not received
possible_causes: Account locked after multiple failed attempts
Wrong registered email/mobile
OTP SMS/email delivery delay
diagnostic_checks: Check account status (active/locked) in the admin console
Verify the registered email/mobile on the account (after identity verification)
Check OTP delivery logs for the user
entries.known_resolution: Unlock the account after identity verification, or guide merchant through 'Forgot password'. If OTP not delivered, check delivery logs and retry; update contact details through the verified change process.

entries.title: SSL/TLS certificate expired or invalid
symptoms: Browser shows 'Your connection is not private' / NET::ERR_CERT_DATE_INVALID
API clients fail with SSL handshake / certificate verify failed errors
Sudden failures across all clients at the same time
possible_causes: Certificate expired and auto-renewal failed
Intermediate certificate chain missing
Wrong certificate deployed for the domain
diagnostic_checks: Check certificate expiry date and chain using openssl s_client or an online checker
Check the auto-renewal job logs (e.g. cert-manager/ACME)
Verify the certificate's domain names match the requested hostname
entries.known_resolution: Renew and deploy the certificate with the full chain, then reload the load balancer/web server. Add an expiry alert at 30/7 days.

entries.title: High CPU / memory on application server
symptoms: Monitoring alert: CPU > 90% or memory > 90%
Application slow or unresponsive
Pods getting OOMKilled / restarting
possible_causes: Traffic spike
Memory leak or inefficient code after deployment
Runaway background job
diagnostic_checks: Check CPU/memory trend and when it started
Correlate with traffic and recent deployments
Check top processes / pod resource usage and restart counts
Check for long-running scheduled/batch jobs
entries.known_resolution: Scale out if traffic-driven. Roll back if a deployment caused it. Stop runaway jobs. Capture heap/thread dump before restarting for root-cause analysis.

entries.title: Server disk space full
symptoms: Error: 'No space left on device'
Disk usage alert above 90%
Application fails to write logs or files
possible_causes: Log files not rotated
Old backups / temp files accumulating
Large core dumps
diagnostic_checks: Run df -h to confirm which filesystem is full
Run du to find the largest directories (often /var/log, /tmp)
Check log rotation configuration
entries.known_resolution: Compress or delete old rotated logs and temp files (never delete active DB files). Fix log rotation. Expand disk if usage is legitimately growing.

entries.title: Employee password reset / account locked (Active Directory)
symptoms: Employee cannot log in to laptop or email
Error: 'Your account has been locked'
Password expired message
possible_causes: Multiple failed login attempts (often from an old password saved on phone)
Password expired per policy
Account disabled by HR offboarding flag
diagnostic_checks: Verify the employee's identity per IT policy
Check account status in Active Directory (locked, expired, disabled)
Check lockout source (which device) if repeated lockouts
entries.known_resolution: Unlock account and/or issue temporary password, require change at next login. For repeated lockouts, ask employee to update the password on phone/mail apps. Disabled accounts go to HR/IAM confirmation.
entries.escalation_team: IT Service Desk (L1) / Identity & Access team

entries.title: VPN not connecting
symptoms: VPN client shows 'Connection failed' or stays at 'Connecting'
Authentication error in VPN client
Connected to VPN but cannot reach internal sites
possible_causes: Home internet issue or restrictive network (hotel/public Wi-Fi)
Expired password or MFA issue
Outdated VPN client
DNS/split-tunnel misconfiguration
diagnostic_checks: Confirm general internet works (open a public website)
Check the user's AD password is not expired and MFA works
Check VPN client version against the supported version
If connected but no internal access, test internal DNS resolution (nslookup internal host)
entries.known_resolution: Reset password/MFA if needed, update VPN client, try a different network or mobile hotspot. DNS issues: reconnect, flush DNS; if persistent, escalate to Network team.

entries.title: Outlook / email not syncing
symptoms: New emails not arriving in Outlook
Outlook shows 'Disconnected' or 'Trying to connect'
Emails stuck in Outbox
possible_causes: Network/VPN issue
Mailbox full
Corrupted Outlook profile or cache
diagnostic_checks: Check if webmail (browser) works for the user
Check mailbox size against quota
Check Outlook connection status and work-offline mode
Try creating a new Outlook profile
entries.known_resolution: Disable Work Offline, clear space if mailbox is full, rebuild Outlook profile/cache. If webmail also fails, check for a service-wide email outage and escalate.

entries.title: Laptop running slow
symptoms: Laptop very slow to boot or open applications
Fan constantly running, high CPU
Frequent freezing
possible_causes: Too many startup apps / browser tabs
Pending OS updates or antivirus scan running
Low disk space or failing disk
diagnostic_checks: Check Task Manager / Activity Monitor for top CPU and memory consumers
Check free disk space
Check for pending updates and restart
Check device health in endpoint management tool
entries.known_resolution: Restart and install pending updates, close heavy apps, free disk space. If hardware health is poor or issue persists, raise a hardware replacement request.
